requirement: Give the landowner written notice before entering the right-of-way
quote: The Company shall give the Owner not less than 48 hours written notice before entering the Lands

requirement: Assess and record crop damage with the landowner before and after any ground disturbance
quote: The Company shall compensate the Owner for crop damage assessed jointly before and after the work

requirement: No ground disturbance during spring road bans
quote: Ground disturbance is not permitted while seasonal road restrictions are in effect
